goal: Prevent bitcoin-cli from hanging indefinitely on empty HTTP responses such as authentication errors
Restore -rpcclienttimeout to an idle timeout so slow or large RPC responses are not prematurely aborted
reviewability: Ready to review with no blockers or invalidating conditions
agreement: Strong support with multiple test verifications and no objections
Verified the empty response test fails on master and passes on this branch (0tuedon, hodlinator)
Verified against a raw listener with zero content length and unauthorized responses (b-l-u-e)
Endorses the optional length approach and tested on FreeBSD (winterrdog)

categories.name: rpc
why: P2 because it fixes two regressions causing bitcoin-cli to hang or prematurely abort active transfers
Restores reliable CLI operation for authentication failures and long-running RPC commands
